Agent Island v0.10.3 is the first formal public release: a local-first Windows command center for Codex and other AI coding agents.

### Highlights

- Real Codex Desktop working and idle state from local lifecycle records.
- Claude Code permission decisions from the island.
- Work, Todos, and memory-only Clipboard pages.
- Edge snapping, side layouts, auto-hide, and a pixel companion.
- Generic loopback REST API plus Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode examples.
- Windows notification capture is available but off by default.

### Privacy defaults

- Clipboard history keeps 30 items in process memory and is explained on first launch.
- Codex prompt text is visible by default to identify the active task; reasoning content is not read.
- Windows notification capture and captured-notification removal are both off by default.
- No telemetry, analytics, cloud account, or background upload.

### Windows download notice

This portable x64 build is not code-signed. Windows SmartScreen may show an “Unknown publisher” warning. Verify the accompanying `.sha256` file before running the executable, or build from source.

Please share bugs in Issues and integration experiences or ideas in Discussions. Never post private prompts, clipboard contents, notification text, tokens, or local paths.
